text_block_list.text:
One day. To secure support for an overseas 
campaign, a networking party with business 
leaders was held at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"How are things coming along with 
establishing the medical support system 
for the overseas campaign?"
choice_data_list: I'll definitely bring it all together!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, what high spirits. I shall go and 
greet everyone, then.

text_block_list.name: Businessperson
text_block_list.text:
It's an honor to meet you, 
Gentildonna-san! We're huge fans of yours!

text_block_list.name: Investor
text_block_list.text:
"The reason I started sponsoring races was 
all because I learned about you!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "My. I am utterly delighted."

text_block_list.name: Investor
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I would never have guessed from 
your demeanor! To think you pulled eight 
harrow tractors all by yourself!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Did you watch that stream?

text_block_list.name: Investor
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I saw it by chance and was so 
shocked! To think such an Umamusume 
existed in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Businessperson
text_block_list.text:
I was really drawn to last year's 
interview video. The intensity coming 
through the screen made me tremble without 
realizing it!

text_block_list.name: Businessperson
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm so thrilled. Wondering how 
you'll take on the world!

text_block_list.name: Investor
text_block_list.text:
We'll do whatever we can. Please let us 
help with your overseas expedition!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I promise you. I shall surely show 
you results beyond your expectations.

After finishing my duties at the party 
venue, I stepped outside for some fresh 
air. Just then...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh. Here you are.
choice_data_list: Hey, how are the greeting rounds going?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Without a hitch. Also, everyone was 
talking about the social media promotion 
and PR videos you worked on.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, they discovered the charm 
of Umamusume and the thrill of racing, 
isn't that right? Everything went just as 
you planned.
choice_data_list: Glad to see it worked out.
Glad to see it worked out.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, you certainly aren't intimidated 
anymore. When we first met, you would have 
been shaking in your boots.
choice_data_list:
They've gained confidence from the 
project's success, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm? —In that case, why don't you show 
me?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Come now, don't just daydream— won't you 
take my hand?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Slow slow, quick quick.

Taking Gentildonna by the hand, we step in 
time beneath the moonlight.

Her immense strength threatens to swing me 
around, but—
choice_data_list:
(Even so, I'll hang on with everything 
I've got—!!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You've grown a bit, haven't you? 
Both in strength and in how you support 
me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, it is complete. A stage 
truly worthy of my dance.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
And now, preparations to take on the world 
are coming together.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Then from here on, it is time to take 
flight.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
France, America... there are so many 
stages to choose from, but which one 
strikes your fancy?
choice_data_list:
The glittering splendor of Dubai is truly 
fitting to adorn you.

The glittering splendor of Dubai is truly 
fitting to adorn you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: In that case, allow me to show you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Upon Dubai's turf, I shall grant you the 
brilliance of the absolute strongest.
